compiled:
📰 General

Netflix Ends ‘The Boroughs’ After One Season, Cutting Ties with Duffer Brothers •

Netflix has decided to cancel the sci-fi drama “The Boroughs,” which was created by the Duffer brothers. The series, centered around a secretive retirement community, concluded after airing a single season. This cancellation marks a significant shift in Netflix’s relationship with the creators of “Stranger Things,” who have been instrumental in the streaming service’s success. Production on “The Boroughs” was reportedly halted due to writers’ and actors’ strikes, contributing to the decision to end the show.

🌍 World

Pentagon’s Iran School Strike Investigation Nears Completion, Sharing Planned •

The Pentagon is finalizing an internal investigation into the deadly airstrike that occurred in a rural area of Iran, targeting what U.S. officials described as an elementary school. Senior military officials are preparing to present the findings to Congress, following a protracted review process. The investigation is examining the circumstances surrounding the strike and the casualties it resulted in. Details regarding the specific number of casualties and the nature of the school remain under investigation. The Pentagon’s aim is to provide lawmakers with a comprehensive assessment of the incident.

🦅 US

Digimon Story: Time Stranger Receives Free Update with New Features July 9th •

A free update for Digimon Story: Time Stranger is scheduled to launch on July 9th for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC. The update introduces a new character, the Terriermon Assistant, designed to aid players in battles. Furthermore, the update adds Graphics Mode options to enhance the game’s visual presentation. This free update expands gameplay options for the digital monster-collecting title.

💰 Business

Midjourney Shifts Focus to Medical Spa Offering AI Body Scanning •

Midjourney, the AI image generation company, has launched a new venture focused on medical imaging and a unique spa experience. The company established a San Francisco-based spa offering body scanning services to customers. Patients undergo scans within a space designed to bathe them in “golden light,” a feature intended to enhance the experience. The spa’s primary goal is to attract customers interested in exploring the technology and its applications. Midjourney intends to utilize the data collected from these scans for research and development purposes.

💻 Technology

Google Health App Overhaul: 502 Changes Aim to Win Back Users •

Google has released a significant update to its Health app, incorporating 502 changes designed to address previous issues and user feedback. The update focuses on resolving reported bugs and introducing previously missing features, including expanded data tracking and improved integration with other Google services. Google stated the changes are part of an effort to reverse initial negative reactions to the app’s launch. The update represents a substantial overhaul of the application’s functionality and aims to improve user experience.

🎭 Entertainment

Zendaya Dominates Met Gala, Showcasing Stunning Custom Valentino Gown •

Zendaya attended the 2024 Met Gala in a breathtaking custom Valentino gown designed by Pierpaolo Piccioli. The dress featured a dramatic, floor-length silhouette with intricate embellishments and a deep V-neckline. She was joined by her partner, Tom Holland, who sported a tailored black suit. The event, themed "Sleeping Beauties: Reawakening Fashion," drew celebrities from across the entertainment industry.

🏅 Sports

Lionel Messi’s Father Receives Medical Care as Argentina Advances in World Cup •

Lionel Messi’s father, Jorge Messi, is currently receiving medical treatment for an unspecified illness. The family has requested privacy and “humanity” as Jorge Messi focuses on supporting his son during Argentina’s World Cup campaign. Details regarding the nature of the illness remain undisclosed, and the family has not released further information. This development occurred as Argentina progressed through the tournament stages. The family’s request for privacy highlights the intense media scrutiny surrounding the Messi family during this global event.

🔬 Science

NASA’s Lucy Mission Uncovers Violent Past of Peculiar Asteroid

NASA’s Lucy spacecraft recently completed a flyby of asteroid 2056 RH, revealing a surprisingly violent formation history. High-resolution images captured by the spacecraft show extensive cratering and fracturing on the asteroid’s surface, indicating a period of intense bombardment. Scientists believe this suggests the asteroid originated from a region of the main asteroid belt that experienced frequent collisions. The findings are helping refine models of the early solar system and the processes that shaped its inner planets.

🩺 Health

Woman’s Suspected Boil Turns Deadly: Flesh-Eating Disease Leads to Coma •

Caroline Fonjock initially believed she had a boil on her leg, but the condition rapidly developed into necrotizing fasciitis, a severe flesh-eating disease. Doctors performed emergency surgery to combat the infection, which was rapidly spreading and posed a significant threat to her life. The disease is often fatal, with approximately one in five cases resulting in death. Fonjock remains in a coma as medical professionals continue to treat the complications arising from the aggressive infection.
